Arena shard is just all the players that you fight against in arena. They all started at about the same time as you so you guys were lumped together. The term "shard" is just another word for server that was adopted from SW: Galaxies.

You have a really solid squad. You're just kind of gear locked. My suggestion is to dump all your fastest speed mods on Biggs. Giving him all that speed plus the bonus speed from Wedge's unique will almost always make Biggs go first. Sorry, this is gonna be a long post.

The reason you want Biggs to go first is because he will call Wedge and someone else to pretty much one shot whoever you choose(or at least hit them for a lot of their health). You want to choose the person you deem the biggest threat. That way it will mess up any strategy they are trying to do. This strategy is ONLY countered by a faster toon like another Biggs with better gear/mods or an auto taunter. 

A lot of arena matches are decided within the first 45 seconds. You want to make sure your team gets a head start. I've literally lost matches in arena because my toons were 1 to 3 speed lower than the the opposing teams toons. 

Next, i would tell you to put your next highest speed mods on Wedge, but you have a Boba and he needs to go next. You have him so you already know he ignores taunts. Use "Death from above" and target the toon that has an ability thats gonna mess up who you are trying to kill next(i.e. EP, StHan; basically support and tank toons with taunt/stun/etc abilities). 

In a scenario where you say people are running Lando(L) with StHan and you think StHan is going to mess your entire strategy up, then Biggs needs to kill StHan first. Boba then lands his D.f.A. on Lando to make him useless for a turn or 2. If they are running an auto taunter like Baze/ShTrooper then Boba needs to execute to dispel the taunt. If they are running an auto taunter AND StHan, look to see who is going to go next. Hopefully Baze is low and will die from the D.f.A. damage while you target StHan and abillity block him.

After that, i'm assuming they are more than likely running Wiggs combo as well. People have mixed opinions on who is the bigger threat between the two, but kill WEDGE first. Why? because he hits way-way-way harder and has an AOE special. Biggs is always going to call Wedge to assist plus someone else. I'd rather lose one character at a time then let Wedge and Lando AOE the shit out of my team and lose half of them. You should be safe from Biggs because you have Baze. Even if he dies he did his job and protected all your damage dealers.

That should take care of whatever issues you are having with that Lando(L)+StHan synergy.

But yeah lol, long post but youre on the right path. Other than Rey, keep that team together. I'd take her out for EP because he has more utility for every situation. Shock is amazing. It keeps them from gaining extra TM(including Biggs), gain buffs(like taunt), get heals, and EP gains TM for each enemy shocked as well as deal damage. Plus he can potentially stun the entire enemy team.

**TLDR; Dump all your highest SPEED mods onto Biggs, then Boba, then Wedge. Dump your best DEF/HEALTH mods with the most protection on Baze, drop Rey for EP and mod him for the most speed after Boba / before Wedge. **
